desc: Implement full solution reading N and S, building the parenthesis tree/forest with a virtual root.
Assign canonical unordered-subtree IDs iteratively using sorted child-ID tuples and a dictionary interning.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N modulo 998244353.
For each node including the virtual root, group children by canonical ID and multiply the answer by fact[degree] * product(invfact[group_size]).
Test edge cases: single pair, deep chain, flat forest, repeated identical subtrees, and sample cases.
